grouping_policy.repository_key: Lowercase owner/repo from Code GitHub URL; use canonical redirect aliases when available.
grouping_policy.unknown_organization: Use repo:<owner> as repository-maintainer label, not a confirmed legal manufacturer; use authors if no repo.
grouping_policy.singleton: Unknown or single-version works retain their own model/project family. Do not force all unknowns into one group.
grouping_policy.official_lineage: A model built on Qwen/Llama/LLaVA/Gemini is not automatically a release of that upstream family.
grouping_policy.shared_repo: A shared repository's stars are a repository-level signal, not per-model or per-paper stars.
grouping_policy.taxonomy_limits: Only official project names/explicit source evidence are mapped; does not audit all paper author affiliations.
grouping_policy.item_kind: Metadata for review. Do not independently delete surveys/datasets/tooling unless the main task's scope policy says so.
grouping_policy.distinct_company_families: Google Gemini/Gemma/PaLI/PaLM-E and Meta Llama/Chameleon/CM3Leon/Muse are separate model families, with the same company field.
